$comment: The kit's design tokens, the single source. tools/gen_tokens.py writes include/kui_tokens.h from it.
The palette holds values; a role is what a style asks for and names one palette entry. Re-pointing a
role repaints every style that uses it, which is how a change of visual language is made: here, never
in a style. The brand entries carry the manual's own names (Rubio & del Amo, V1 June 2026, p. 24).
The entries from row_dark on are the greys and greens of kshell's look, the only ground the glass has: a black page, dark rows, one yellow for what you press and where the cursor is.
The panel's geometry is not here: kbsp describes the board, and KUI_RADIUS_GLASS reads it from there.

palette.name: page
palette.help: The AMOLED page: black costs nothing

palette.name: row_dark
palette.help: A row on the page: a shade up from Soft Black, so it reads as a surface and not as a hole

palette.name: off_grey
palette.help: A control at rest, lighter than a row

palette.name: rest_grey
palette.help: The resting grey of a track or a disabled thing: warm, and legible against a row

palette.name: ok_green
palette.help: Done and healthy, on a dark ground

palette.name: charge_green
palette.help: Charging and paired: a lighter green than ok, so the two are never read as one

palette.name: danger_red
palette.help: An ending, and what cannot be undone: Power off, Remove

roles.name: bg
roles.help: The page: true black, AMOLED pixels off

roles.name: text_on_bg
roles.help: Text sitting on the page or on a row

roles.name: surface
roles.help: A row: a pill at rest

roles.name: sheet
roles.help: A sheet's card: the page itself

roles.name: text
roles.help: Dark ink: text on a lit fill (Light Grey, yellow, blue), never a ground

roles.name: on_accent
roles.help: Text on Kody Blue or Bold Yellow: Light Grey would read 2.7:1 on the blue and 1.3:1 on the yellow

roles.name: off
roles.help: A control at rest: a switch that is off

roles.name: rest
roles.help: The track a level fills over, a pill held down, and a disabled thing

roles.name: accent
roles.help: Kody and connections only; the cursor is the focus ring, not this

roles.name: level
roles.help: A level (how bright, how loud): the part of a track that is filled

roles.name: action
roles.help: What you press: the one answer button of a sheet

roles.name: track
roles.help: Borders, scrollbars and the lines of a drawing

roles.name: focus
roles.help: The focus ring: the cursor of the pad

roles.name: warn
roles.help: Low battery, and anything that will stop on its own: the action yellow, since the page has no orange

roles.name: danger
roles.help: Critically low battery, and the one control whose job is an ending

sizes.name: space_sm
sizes.help: Small spacing and padding unit

sizes.name: space_md
sizes.help: Default spacing and padding unit

sizes.name: space_lg
sizes.help: Large spacing unit: the gap between two pills, anywhere

sizes.name: border_width
sizes.help: Default border width

sizes.name: screen_side
sizes.help: Plain side margin

sizes.name: screen_top
sizes.help: Where the first row begins

sizes.name: screen_bottom
sizes.help: Where the last row ends

sizes.name: pill_h
sizes.help: A pill at rest. Four of them plus their gaps fit the launcher's viewport

sizes.name: pill_w
sizes.help: A full-width pill: 410 of glass less screen_side twice

sizes.name: icon_slot
sizes.help: The round slot on a pill's left: an icon, a letter or a count rides in it

sizes.name: cat_h
sizes.help: A category tab's height: a readout of which filter is on, not a row of the list

sizes.name: hdr_disc
sizes.help: The disc in a sheet's header: the page's picture

sizes.name: progress_h
sizes.help: The Opening sheet's progress pill

sizes.name: action_h
sizes.help: An action button in a sheet's body

sizes.name: action_w
sizes.help: An action button's width: the one answer at the foot of a sheet

sizes.name: ring_w
sizes.help: The focus ring's width

sizes.name: ring_gap
sizes.help: The gap between an object and its focus ring, outside it

sizes.name: level_h
sizes.help: A level's track: the bar a finger drags its knob along

sizes.name: level_knob_pad
sizes.help: How far a level's knob stands out of its track

sizes.name: swatch
sizes.help: A colour swatch's diameter: a colour to tap, ringed when chosen

sizes.name: lamp_glow
sizes.help: How far a lamp's glow reaches past its disc

sizes.name: lamp_glow_spread
sizes.help: Where a lamp's glow starts outside its disc
